Hi Nidhi,

Thanks again for applying to the Senior Product Manager role at Redwood. We'd love to set up a 30-minute phone screen with Marissa (hiring manager) next week. To make this easy I pulled a few evening windows in your timezone (NZST/NZDT) — let me know which one works best or propose alternatives: 

- Tue, Nov 7 — 8:00–8:30 PM NZDT (UTC+13) — corresponds to Tue 3:00–3:30 AM PDT
- Wed, Nov 8 — 7:30–8:00 PM NZDT (UTC+13) — corresponds to Wed 2:30–3:00 AM PDT
- Thu, Nov 9 — 9:00–9:30 PM NZDT (UTC+13) — corresponds to Thu 4:00–4:30 AM PDT

If none of those work, please share 2–3 30-minute windows that do and your timezone label (NZST or NZDT) so I can double-check. I'm happy to send a calendar invite (with a Zoom link) once we lock a time.

Attached is the resume I have on file — if you have an updated copy, feel free to send it back.

Thanks,
